name: acl
description: Get ACL entries, can be filter by path.

params.name: all-for-authid
params.description: Whether to return all ACL entries for the exact current authid only. All ACL entries will appear as `AclUgidType::User` ACLs, regardles of whether they are stored as user or group entries. Hence, when using this parameter this endpoint cannot be used to retrieve information for updating the ACL tree directly.

params.name: exact
params.description: If set, returns only ACL for the exact path.

roleid.description: A role represented as a string.

ugid_type.description: Type of the 'ugid' property in the ACL entry list.

permissions.description: Returns all ACLs if a user has sufficient privileges on this endpoint. Otherwise it is limited to the user's API tokens. However, if `all-for-authid` is specified, all ACLs of the current Authid will be returned, whether the Authid has privileges to list other ACLs here or not.
